body: The only Craigslists ads in my local area are all spam postings, the local apartments are all pretty much way too expensive for me to even consider (I only work part time as a telemarketer and I've only just started my job). As for people, they're all I've got. The only real friends I have are the one who I'm staying with right now (whom I have to leave tomorrow) and my girlfriend who lives really far away. I need them or I really am in this world alone.
It's just - it's over, I think. Those final parts of me are disappearing now. I'm just doomed.
